name: haven-customer-app
description: Haven — home services marketplace customer app. Single-file React PWA prototype (home_services_app.jsx), compiled in-browser via Babel Standalone, no bundler. These devDependencies are for the local audit test suite only — the shipped app itself loads React/ReactDOM/Babel/jsPDF from CDN (see _shell_pre.txt), not from node_modules.

scripts.test: node audit.test.js && node verification_claims.test.js && node dark_mode_contrast.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run boot-check && npm test && node signout_confirmation.test.js && node scroll_restore.test.js && node edge_swipe_touch.test.js && node fullscreen_layout.test.js && node myhome_properties.test.js
